name: Social Autopilot 8: Check Connections
description: Run by hand: checks the Telegram bot, approver, channel rights and LinkedIn connection, saves the LinkedIn member ID and reports in Telegram.

parameters.content:
## Check Connections (run by hand)
Run after setup and whenever something stops posting. Checks the bot token (and removes any old webhook), the approver, that the n8n Telegram credential is the same bot, the bot's admin rights in the channel, and LinkedIn.

It also saves your LinkedIn member ID to the data table, which **Publish Post** needs. The result is in the **Report** node and sent to you in Telegram.
